Victory! Soon, the faction behaved less and less like it originally did. Yes, crime remained, but it decreased. The leadership pushed an ideology closer to what the "Freedom" faction promoted, while the lower ranks were slow to adopt these new ideals, as old methods like robbery and looting seemed simpler and more understandable. Victory! Soon, the faction behaved less and less like it originally did. Crime significantly decreased. The leadership pushed an anti-Zone agenda more and more. Victory! Soon, the faction behaved less and less like it originally did. Crime significantly decreased. A strict hierarchy was enforced. The situation was best described as a "Penal Battalion". A new large-scale conflict was brewing, but this time within the faction itself...
